authority: Konami official Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Card Database
purpose: Source verification and implementation triage for worklist entries 21–31, completing the factual review of all 31 candidates in the current milestone artifact. This is not runtime support or certification.

sourcePolicy.cardText: Effect descriptions are concise paraphrases of the official card text.
sourcePolicy.historicalCutoff: Historical eligibility remains pending an OCG/TCG first-publication audit against 2004-09-30; a TCG reprint date must not be used to infer original eligibility.
sourcePolicy.certification: No card is certified by source review or import. Behavioral certification requires implemented engine behavior and passing real-engine tests.

reusableFamilies.sharedWork: Standby/End Phase timing, self-send, hand/Deck Special Summon, typed discard and ATK-threshold destruction.
Plant/Warrior tribute identity, shared Field Zone conditions, team-wide opponent targeting.
On-sent-to-GY trigger, face-up monster target, equip lifetime and ATK modifier.
Shared field counters, standby upkeep, continuous ATK/DEF recalculation.
Attack-all-monsters permission, no Special Summon, End Phase return.
Damage-event recipient, battle-destruction actor, Trap recovery to Deck top and fixed burn.

cards.name: Arcane Archer of the Forest
cards.effectSummary: While its controller has a Plant monster on the field, it cannot be attacked; it can Tribute one Plant monster to destroy one Spell or Trap on the field.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The protection condition counts Plant monsters across the team's shared Monster Zones.
The Tribute must be a Plant monster on the shared field; physical ownership must be preserved if the partner's monster is used as cost.
The target may be any Spell/Trap on the field, including the opponent's shared backrow.
Removing the last Plant must immediately restore attack legality.

cards.name: Archfiend of Gilfer
cards.effectSummary: When sent to the GY, it may target a face-up monster on the field, equip itself to that monster, and reduce that monster's ATK by 500 while equipped.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The trigger is being sent to the GY, not only battle destruction.
The target can be any face-up monster on either team's shared field.
The equip relationship must preserve Archfiend of Gilfer's physical owner and the equipped monster's controller.
The -500 ATK modifier must end when the equip card leaves its equipped state.

cards.name: Archlord Zerato
cards.effectSummary: It cannot be Normal Summoned/Set and requires Tributing a face-up Warrior of Zera while The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field; while that Field Spell remains on its controller's side, discarding a LIGHT monster destroys all opposing monsters.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The Special Summon requires both the exact face-up Warrior of Zera Tribute and the shared Field Zone condition.
The destruction effect is inactive unless The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the controller's side of the shared field.
Discard exactly one LIGHT monster from the activating physical player's hand, not the partner's private hand.
Destroy all monsters on the opposing team's shared field and respect the three Monster Zone cap after resolution.

cards.name: Armed Dragon LV3
cards.effectSummary: During its controller's Standby Phase, it may send itself to the GY to Special Summon Armed Dragon LV5 from hand or Deck.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: Offer the effect in the correct controller's Standby Phase only.
Sending LV3 to the GY is the activation cost and must happen exactly once.
Special Summon LV5 from the physical controller's hand or Deck, not the inactive partner's private zones.
Preserve the chain's physical ownership across subsequent team-seat rotations.

cards.name: Armed Dragon LV5
cards.effectSummary: It may discard a monster, then destroy one opposing monster whose ATK does not exceed the discarded monster's ATK; during the End Phase, if it destroyed a monster by battle that turn, it may send itself to the GY to summon Armed Dragon LV7 from hand or Deck.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The discarded monster must come from the activating physical player's hand and its ATK determines the legal target threshold.
Target only an opposing monster; include either opposing physical seat's shared Monster Zone.
The End Phase level-up requires a battle destruction by this card during the current turn, not an effect destruction.
The LV7 summon uses the physical controller's hand or Deck and preserves card ownership.

cards.name: Armed Dragon LV7
cards.effectSummary: It cannot be Normal Summoned/Set and must be Special Summoned by Armed Dragon LV5; it may discard a monster to destroy every opposing monster whose ATK does not exceed that discarded monster's ATK.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: Enforce the LV5-only Special Summon procedure; ordinary Special Summons and Graveyard revival are not legal.
Discard one monster from the activating physical player's hand and use its ATK as the threshold.
Apply the threshold to all monsters across the opposing team's shared field, including both physical seats.
Do not destroy monsters above the threshold and preserve all remaining physical UIDs.

cards.name: Armor Exe
cards.effectSummary: It cannot attack during the turn it is Normal, Flip, or Special Summoned; during each player's Standby Phase, its controller must remove one Spell Counter from their side of the field or destroy Armor Exe.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The attack lock applies for the summon turn regardless of which physical teammate becomes active later.
The upkeep occurs during both teams' Standby Phases while the monster remains face-up.
The Spell Counter must be removed from a legal card on its controller's team field; do not consume the partner's private resource.
If no Spell Counter is available, destroy Armor Exe before proceeding.

cards.name: Arsenal Bug
cards.effectSummary: If its controller has no other Insect monsters on the field, its ATK and DEF become 1000 instead of their printed values.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: Count other Insect monsters across the team's shared Monster Zones.
Arsenal Bug itself does not satisfy the 'other Insect' condition.
Recalculate immediately when another Insect enters or leaves the field.
Restore printed 2000/2000 when the condition becomes false; do not persist a temporary modifier.

cards.name: Asura Priest
cards.effectSummary: It cannot be Special Summoned; at the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, it returns to the hand; it may attack each opposing monster once.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: Reject all Special Summon attempts for this Spirit monster.
The return trigger is tied to the End Phase of the turn it was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up.
Its multi-attack allowance covers monsters on both opposing physical seats, each at most once.
Verify direct-attack legality separately from the text's attack-all-monsters permission; do not infer an extra restriction.

cards.name: Aswan Apparition
cards.effectSummary: If it inflicts battle damage, its controller may return one Trap from the Graveyard to the top of their Deck.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: Trigger only when battle damage is actually inflicted; zero damage does not resolve the recovery.
Select a Trap from the team's shared Graveyard while preserving its physical owner metadata.
Place it on top of the activating physical player's Deck, not the partner's Deck.
Resolve the recovery after battle damage and before the next draw.

cards.name: Atomic Firefly
cards.effectSummary: If this face-up monster attacks or is attacked and is destroyed by battle, the player who destroyed it takes 1000 damage.
twoVTwoReviewQuestions: The source must be face-up when the battle event begins and be destroyed by battle.
The damage recipient is the player/team that destroyed Atomic Firefly, not automatically the team that controlled it.
Apply the 1000 damage once, regardless of which physical seat controlled the attacker.
Do not trigger on effect destruction, face-down destruction, or when Atomic Firefly survives.
